title: 2026 iPad mini review: Maximizing the mini
gist: Apple's 2026 iPad mini adds an 8.5-inch OLED, the 2nm A20 Pro chip, in-house N1 wireless and C2 cellular chips, and the first IP67 rating on an iPad. But its starting price rose to $699 from $499 in 2024, just $50 below the 11-inch iPad Air, so the reviewer still calls it a niche product.

insights.claim: The 2026 iPad mini starts at $699 for 128GB, up from $499 for the 2024 model, putting it just $50 below the 11-inch iPad Air (M4), while the tested 512GB configuration costs $999.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: A $200 entry-price increase signals Apple pushing ASPs up through premium components like OLED.
insights.locator: These improvements come with a pricing predicament

insights.claim: The reviewer concludes that despite its upgrades the iPad mini remains a niche product, with the iPad Air a better power-portability balance and the iPad Pro best for demanding workloads.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Narrow price gaps risk cannibalization within Apple's tablet lineup rather than expanding the market.
insights.locator: Despite narrowing the gap with other tablets

insights.claim: The 2026 iPad mini replaces its 8.3-inch IPS screen with an 8.5-inch 2316x1512 OLED rated at 600 nits full-screen and 1,200 nits peak HDR, with bezels reduced 24%, but keeps a 60 Hz refresh rate.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: OLED spreading down Apple's iPad lineup expands demand for small/mid-size OLED panels.

insights.claim: The mini jumps from the 3nm A17 Pro to the 2nm A20 Pro from the iPhone 18 Pro, with 50% more memory bandwidth and up to 60% faster performance; the 512GB model gets six CPU cores and two Neural Engines for on-device AI.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Apple is spreading 2nm silicon and on-device AI hardware across more devices, sustaining leading-edge foundry demand.

insights.claim: The 2026 iPad mini uses Apple's N1 wireless chip (adding Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6 and Thread), launched with the iPhone 17 series, and the C2 cellular modem introduced in the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Continued rollout of in-house modem and wireless silicon displaces third-party chip suppliers in Apple devices.

insights.claim: Eliminating visible speaker holes helped the 2026 mini earn the first IP67 rating for an iPad, while battery life matched the predecessor despite a smaller chassis and larger screen.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Durability and design upgrades support Apple's premium pricing strategy.
